# Follow-Up: Measuring Whether Vulnerability Reports Generated by AI Are Actually Used by Maintainers

**Problem:** AI tools can generate detailed vulnerability reports and patches, but it is unknown what fraction of AI-generated reports are acted upon by project maintainers vs. ignored.

**Direction:** Search GitHub issue trackers and pull requests for AI-generated security reports (using characteristic language patterns from known AI security tools like CodeQL AI suggestions, Copilot security alerts). For a sample of 50 AI-generated security reports, measure: time-to-close, closed-with-patch rate, maintainer response quality.

**Why it matters:** If AI-generated security reports are systematically ignored, the detection improvement from AI tools does not translate to security improvement. Understanding why reports are ignored enables report quality improvement.

**Relevant context:** Dependabot/GitHub security advisory alerts are partly AI-generated and their acceptance rates are partially studied. AI-generated vulnerability report acceptance rates for LLM-generated reports specifically not measured.
